column2: Teachers hoped the new school rules would civilize the noisy, wild playground.
column3: 老師希望新的校規能讓吵鬧又瘋野的操場變得有規矩。
column4: civilize a wild land (使荒野開化)
column5: civil 是「公民的」，把野孩子變成有禮的公民就是 civilize

column2: The mechanic clamped the pipe to the table before cutting it.
column3: 技師在切割水管前，先把它夾緊在桌上。
column4: clamp a pipe tight (把管子夾緊)
column5: clamp 像「卡郎」兩個音，卡住郎(東西)就夾緊了

column2: Before breakfast, she cleanses her face with warm water and mild soap.
column3: 早餐前，她用溫水和溫和的肥皂清洗臉部。
column5: clean 加 se：把東西變乾淨的動作，臉也能被 cleanse

column2: He clenched his fists and tried to stay calm during the argument.
column3: 爭吵時他握緊拳頭，努力保持冷靜。
column5: clench 的 ch 像用力「擠」，手握緊緊擠出力氣

column2: Scientists cloned a sheep named Dolly in 1996 from a single cell.
column3: 科學家在 1996 年用一顆細胞複製出一隻名叫桃莉的羊。
column5: 克隆(clone)就是諧音：複製出一模一樣的「克隆」羊

column2: Two scooters collided at the corner, but nobody was hurt badly.
column3: 兩輛機車在轉角相撞，但沒有人傷得嚴重。
column4: collide with a car (與車相撞)
column5: col 一起 + lide 像 slide 滑：滑到一起就撞上了

column2: Every April, our town holds a parade to commemorate its founding.
column3: 每年四月，我們鎮上舉行遊行來紀念建鎮。
column5: com 一起 + memor 記憶：大家一起記住某件大事

column2: She compiled a list of useful websites for her classmates.
column3: 她為同學整理了一份實用網站清單。
column5: com 一起 + pile 堆：把資料堆在一起編成一份

column2: The team comprises five students, two teachers, and one coach.
column3: 這個隊伍由五名學生、兩位老師和一位教練組成。
column4: comprise five members (由五位成員組成)
column5: comprise 用「包住」想：整體把各部分包起來，不加 of

column2: The university will confer an honorary degree on the famous writer.
column3: 大學將頒授榮譽學位給這位知名作家。
column5: con 一起 + fer 帶：把學位帶給你，就是授予

column2: The little boy covets his cousin's shiny new bicycle.
column3: 小男孩很眼紅表哥那輛閃亮的新腳踏車。
column5: cover 蓋住：看到別人的好東西，想拿來蓋上自己的名字

column2: Tiny apartments cramp families who need more space to live comfortably.
column3: 狹小的公寓限制了需要更多空間舒適生活的家庭。
column4: cramp my style (束縛我的行動)
column5: 抽筋 cramp 讓你動彈不得，空間太小也一樣被限制

column2: The old man crooked his finger to call the children closer.
column3: 老先生彎起手指，招呼孩子們靠近一點。
column5: crook 像鉤子 hook 的樣子，手指彎成一個鉤

column2: Our boat cruised slowly along the coast while we watched dolphins.
column3: 我們的船沿著海岸緩緩航行，我們一邊看海豚。
column4: cruise along the coast (沿海岸巡航)
column5: cruise 諧音「裘伊絲」，想像裘伊絲悠閒開船慢慢逛

column2: The old cookie crumbled into tiny pieces when she squeezed it.
column3: 她一捏，那塊舊餅乾就碎成小塊。
column5: crumb 是碎屑，加 le 變動詞：變成碎屑

column2: The shop's sales declined sharply after the new mall opened nearby.
column3: 附近新商場開幕後，這家店的銷售量大幅下降。
column5: de 往下 + cline 傾斜：往下斜，所以是下降

column2: She dedicated her whole life to helping children learn to read.
column3: 她把一生都奉獻給幫助孩子學習閱讀。
column4: dedicate your life to (終生奉獻於)
column5: dedicate 像「嫡弟 kate」，最親的人才會全心投入

column2: The storm deprived the village of electricity for three whole days.
column3: 暴風雨讓村子整整三天沒有電可用。
column4: deprive someone of sleep (剝奪睡眠)
column5: de 去除 + prive 像 private 私有：把你的東西拿走

column2: The hikers slowly descended the mountain before the sun went down.
column3: 登山客趁日落前慢慢走下山。
column5: de 往下 + scend 爬：往下爬，與 ascend 相反

column2: Press the button to detach the handle from the vacuum cleaner.
column3: 按下按鈕就能把握把從吸塵器上拆下來。
column5: de 分開 + tach 像 attach 黏上：把黏上的拆開

column2: Police detained the driver for two hours to ask more questions.
column3: 警方扣留這名駕駛兩小時，詢問更多問題。
column5: de 向下 + tain 抓住：抓住不放，所以留住

column2: The government decided not to devalue its currency this year.
column3: 政府今年決定不讓貨幣貶值。
column5: de 減少 + value 價值：價值變少

column2: The doctor diagnosed her cough as a mild case of the flu.
column3: 醫生診斷她的咳嗽是輕微的流感。
column5: dia 透過 + gnose 知道：看透症狀才知道病因

column2: The teacher diagrammed the sentence on the board for the class.
column3: 老師在黑板上為全班用圖解表示這個句子。
column5: diagram 名詞是圖表，當動詞就是畫成圖

column2: The boss dictated a short letter while his secretary typed it.
column3: 老闆口述一封短信，秘書就邊聽邊打字。
column5: dict 說：dictionary 字典就是說明字的書

column2: A strong storm disabled the radio tower, so people lost the signal.
column3: 強烈風暴讓無線電塔無法運作，人們因此收不到訊號。
column4: disable a security alarm (使警報器失效)
column5: dis 不 + able 能：變成不能運作

column2: My parents disapprove of staying up late on school nights.
column3: 我爸媽不贊成在上學日的夜晚熬夜。
column4: disapprove of the plan (不贊成這計畫)
column5: dis 不 + approve 贊成，後面常接 of

column2: The loud construction noise discomforted the patients in the nearby clinic.
column3: 嘈雜的施工聲讓附近診所的病人很不舒服。
column4: discomfort the guests (讓客人不自在)
column5: dis 不 + comfort 舒適：讓人不舒服

column2: His cheating on the test disgraced the whole class.
column3: 他考試作弊讓全班都丟了臉。
column5: dis 失去 + grace 優雅：失去體面，所以丟臉

column2: New machines have displaced many workers in the old factory.
column3: 新機器取代了老工廠裡的許多工人。
column5: dis 離開 + place 位置：把人擠離原位

column2: Nothing displeases my grandmother more than wasting good food.
column3: 沒有什麼比浪費好食物更讓我奶奶不高興了。
column4: displease the teacher (讓老師不高興)
column5: dis 不 + please 取悅：不能讓人開心

column2: Some drivers disregard the speed limit when the road is empty.
column3: 有些駕駛在路上沒車時會無視速限。
column5: dis 不 + regard 看重：不看在眼裡

column2: We tried to dissuade him from swimming in the cold river.
column3: 我們想勸他不要到冰冷的河裡游泳。
column4: dissuade him from going (勸他別去)
column5: dis 反對 + suade 勸說，與 persuade 說服相反

column2: Don't let your phone distract you while you are doing homework.
column3: 寫功課時別讓手機使你分心。
column5: dis 分開 + tract 拉：把注意力拉走

column2: After being lied to twice, she began to distrust her old friend.
column3: 被騙兩次後，她開始不信任這位老朋友。
column4: distrust a stranger (不信任陌生人)
column5: dis 不 + trust 信任

column2: Because of the accident, police diverted traffic onto a smaller road.
column3: 由於發生事故，警方把車流引導到較小的路上。
column5: di 分開 + vert 轉：轉到別的方向

column2: Many students donated their old books to the village library.
column3: 許多學生把舊書捐給村裡的圖書館。
column5: donate 諧音「都那」，都拿出來給別人

column2: The lack of rain doomed the farmers' crops to failure.
column3: 缺雨使農民的作物注定歉收。
column5: doom 像「度姆」，想像命運的門早已關上，改不了

column2: It drizzled all morning, so we took our umbrellas to the park.
column3: 整個早上都下著毛毛雨，所以我們帶傘去公園。
column4: drizzle all day (整天下毛毛雨)
column5: drizzle 的 zzle 聽起來像細雨沙沙沙

column2: Workers dynamited the huge rock to make a tunnel through the hill.
column3: 工人用炸藥炸開巨石，好在山裡開隧道。
column5: dynamite 諧音「搭那邁」，邁出大步炸開山
